title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1553: Start of battle (3)

section.p: Han Xiang sighed and said, “Su Yu, the human race has suffered nine defeats. Do you think the human race can survive a tenth defeat?”
At that, the various experts started releasing their auras.

Su Yu saw that there were too many Invincibles around him, including even those from the minor races. He was unsure if their participation was forced or voluntary. He even saw the Mystic Armor King among them. What a surprise. That was the sole king left in that race. What was he doing here?

When Su Yu thought about it, he laughed in amusement. It was understandable. He was such a petty person. After his feat of killing several Invincibles today, it was only natural for the Mystic Armor King to feel even more threatened. In that case, he would naturally try to kill Su Yu when such a great opportunity was present. He was surprisingly decisive. He had opted to face the issue instead of hiding away.
Slowly, Han Xiang’s crooked back straightened as she said, “Guardians, are you really unwilling to take a step back? After nine epochs, have you not seen how things are?”
Heavendoom asked coldly, “Han Xiang, are you dying to taste my staff?”
Su Yu glanced at Heavendoom, but noticing the ferocious glint in Heavendoom’s eyes, he decided not to say anything about that question.
Han Xiang smiled, “Senior Heavendoom is valiant and mighty. Han Xiang is unworthy of you. Bountiful Treasure General, why don’t you entertain Senior Heavendoom for a bit?”

Up in the sky, Bountiful Treasure General had a helpless expression as he heard that. He sighed and said, “I have known Brother Heavendoom for many years. Han Xiang, you’re making things difficult for me.”
Han Xiang said with the same respectful tone, “General, my Emperor promises to lend you the Immortal Emperor’s Stele for an epoch if you’re willing to help with this.”

After a short silence, Bountiful Treasure General looked at Heavendoom and walked out of the Allheaven Treasure House. He sighed again and said, “Brother Heavendoom, I have affirmed my dao through my possession of countless treasures. Alas, that was also why I have never been able to achieve Daofuse. The Immortal Emperor’s Stele might be the exact treasure I need to achieve Daofuse. It has been too long. I can’t wait any longer.”

Heavendoom had a solemn expression. This was an ancient titled general who had been a step away from achieving Daofuse a hundred thousand years ago. Even back then, the two of them were similar in strength.

Heavendoom had been serving as a guardian for a hundred thousand years while Bountiful Treasure had suffered grave injuries from He Tu during the first epoch. Thus, the two were still similar in strength even after so many years. It would be hard to judge which among them was stronger.

Heavendoom inhaled deeply as the ferocious glint in his eyes faded slightly. He sent Su Yu a voice transmission, “Be careful. Bountiful Treasure isn’t easy to face. I’ll do my best to either defeat him or keep him busy.”
If even the proud Heavendoom was saying such words, it was clear this was a tricky opponent.

Su Yu did not seem worried. He cupped his fists and said, “May you return victorious, Lord. Don’t worry too much even if you can’t kill him. Bountiful Treasure General? I love someone with bountiful treasures. If both of us survive this, I will settle things with him in the future for his interference today.”

Hearing that, Bountiful Treasure’s expression changed. A supreme genius like Su Yu would not give empty promises. If he didn’t die here, he would most certainly pursue revenge upon gaining enough strength. Nobody would take the words of someone like that lightly.

With a bitter expression, Bountiful Treasure General said, “The human race is indeed as domineering as ever. So be it. I have to do this due to my dao. If you were to survive this, I would naturally pay the price.”
Su Yu smiled, “Don’t worry, General. It probably won’t happen too soon in the future.”
Bountiful Treasure looked even more helpless upon hearing that.
He looked at the immortals and said, “One more epoch or I’ll leave now. Heavendoom is worth an epoch. Su Yu alone is worth an epoch as well.”
Han Xiang frowned slightly, but she soon nodded, “You have a deal.”
“This way, Brother Heavendoom.”
With a sigh, Bountiful Treasure ripped space apart, revealing the boundless void beyond the opening. That would be the site of their battle.
As the expression of Heavendoom changed slightly, Su Yu said, “Lord, just take your staff with you. It’s fine if you can’t kill him, but please make him feel some pain.”
Heavendoom looked at Su Yu.

He said nothing and reached out. Once again, the ancient city transformed into a staff and flew into his hand. Far away, Bountiful Treasure sighed again. This was such a difficult job. With his weapon, Heavendoom would be even stronger.
Heavendoom said, “Bountiful Treasure, today, I will teach you who your granddaddy is. Our battle will not end before you call me granddaddy.”

With a flicker, Heavendoom shattered the space in front of him and stepped into the boundless void. Before the opening could even close, he swept his staff out, creating numerous explosions in the boundless void.

In the blink of an eye, Heavendoom’s afterimages appeared everywhere as he attacked madly, as though he had returned into the mad beast that he was during the ancient past. As for Bountiful Treasure, he faced Heavendoom with countless treasures, living up to his title as the Bountiful Treasure General.

Despite his valiant resistance, Bountiful Treasure was not able to stop Heavendoom, who had been holding back for a hundred thousand years. He fought madly, smashing Bountiful Treasure apart with his gigantic staff in mere moments.
But soon, the body recovered to how it was. Bountiful Treasure’s voice rang out, “Fuck! Tiangu, three epochs or I’ll leave now!”
“Sure.”
Tiangu’s voice rang out. He had agreed to the request. Why? Because Heavendoom was not an easy opponent.
Next, Grandstar and Empyrean Cloud inhaled and looked at Su Yu. When he nodded at them, the two looked at Han Xiang. With a sneer, Empyrean Cloud said, “Little Whore, come play with your grandma.”
Su Yu raised his thumb at Grandma Empyrean Cloud. Han Xiang’s face turned cold. She ripped space apart and stepped into the boundless space without any hesitation. The two guardians did the same.
Following that, one ancient fossil after another stepped forward. One after another, the guardians stepped into the boundless space with these ancient fossils.
Eventually, only three guardians were left behind Su Yu. However, there were still more than ten Invincibles around them. The three did not intend to leave. Nothing was more important than Su Yu.
Without Su Yu, they wouldn’t even be able to leave their cities. Thus, they wouldn’t leave his side no matter what.
Great Qin King looked around and noted that some Invincibles were surrounding them as well, including Dao King, the white-haired divine king, and Devil King Moge.
All of them were experts.
There were fifteen of them in total.
The myriad races were clearly very determined to kill Su Yu this time. They had deployed around seventeen ancient fossils and roughly thirty regular Invincibles to keep the guardians occupied.
There were also more than ten around the human Invincibles and more than ten still surrounding Su Yu.

All in all, about eighty Invincibles had been mobilized for the task of killing Su Yu. The number might be lower than the previous conflict, but the quality of the involved experts this time was much higher.

The white-haired divine king solemnly said, “Think carefully. The human race is still around, but that’s not because you’re strong. Rather, the various races have simply not reached a proper reason to join hands for a final battle. But the survival of Su Yu will be a good reason for us to join hands for real.”
Great Xia King looked at the white-haired divine king and said, “What makes you think you’re qualified to say this in front of us after losing a body?”
“You can try us.”
An old divine king with an even whiter hair stepped forth and said, “Are you going to make a move?”
At the sight of the newcomer, Great Xia King’s expression changed slighly as he exclaimed, “Six-winged!”
That was the king of the six-winged divine race. The absolute ruler of that race.
He was comparable to Blood Fire, and he was even older than Blood Fire.
The Six-winged Divine King said, “Return to the Eastrift Valley and peace between us shall last. Otherwise, pay the price for your foolishness.”
Great Qin King looked at the distant Su Yu, who was still looking as calm as ever. He inhaled deeply.
Leave?
Where to?
At their departure, the Invincibles around them would join the Invincibles around Su Yu. And there was nobody left on Su Yu’s side capable of stopping an expert like the Six-winged Divine King.
This was a checkmate.
The myriad races had gone crazy.

Only now did Great Qin King realize that there were still so many late-degree Eternals hidden among the myriad races. Clearly, they had been holding back in the past. Retreating was no longer an option.
He turned to look in the Human Realm’s direction before looking at his old comrades. He smiled a rather natural smile and said, “Brothers. Shall we do it once more?”
“Yeah.”
“Up to you.”
“As usual, you have the final say on the battlefield.”
The human Invincibles gave their answers.
Great Qin King’s smile widened, but it vanished after a moment. In its place, a grave expression appeared.
“Die!”
A roar reverberated in the sky.
Then, a massive saber shot into the sky before descending. It was incredibly powerful, comparable to his previous peak combat strength.

All along, everyone had been assuming that he was Great Ming King. However, he had attacked with a saber instead. Furthermore, his saber seemed even stronger than Great Xia King’s. One of the enemy Invincibles was unable to avoid in time and was cut in two. Just like that, a tri-life body was killed.
An intense battle erupted.
“Die!”
With a roar, Great Xia King and the other Invincibles attacked as well. Space collapsed around them as they all entered the boundless space one after another.
Today, they shall dine in blood!
“How…boring.”

Su Yu sighed. What were they doing? He had been waiting for those Invincibles to gather around him before opening the death tunnel. Great Qin King was making things difficult for him. Should he still open the death tunnel?

This trick might only work once. It might not be worth using against the enemies currently surrounding him. After all, the three guardians behind him were strong enough. He himself was also strong enough. There might not be a need for him to open the death tunnel to handle these opponents.
What a difficult choice to make.
“Lord Eternal Serenity, shall we have some fun with them?”
Su Yu smiled. The guardians behind him smiled as well. Sure. Let’s have some fun.
They attacked in a formation surrounding Su Yu. In the blink of an eye, numerous shockwaves rippled out, creating massive waves in the Sea of Stars.
Standing in the middle of the three guardians, Su Yu did not attack. He was not fast enough to actively join the battle. Rather, he was waiting for someone to come after him.

There was no worry that nobody would do that. After all, he was the main character here. Sure enough, a River of Time unfurled before him not long after. Su Yu’s eyes turned cold as he threw a fist. With a deafening rumble, the entire river shook as an Invincible stepped back with a look of overwhelming shock.
